research_role: Prospective development comparison on eight identity-selected Dev cases not previously executed by either study arm.
research_question: Does preserving the first clean-replay-certified complete program improve end-to-end deployment success over soft target-state replay alone?

motivation.bad6_observation: Soft target-state replay repaired post-candidate target-state failures, but multiple Agents reached the public goal and still ended without a submission.
motivation.prior_qualification: The certified-incumbent implementation was safety-qualified on three consumed cases, but its effect relative to soft replay was not established.
motivation.single_change: C stores every clean-replay-passed complete program and may return the latest one after provider or safety-cap termination; B requires an explicit final Agent submission.

selection.rule: Take the first eight rows in the pre-existing source order.

B-FSR.description: One continuous Agent session with advisory whole-program target-state replay.

C-GCI.description: B plus harness retention of the latest clean-replay-certified complete program.

shared_execution.seed_assignment: 620001 through 620008 in source order, assigned before execution.
shared_execution.episode_order: Alternating C-first and B-first pairs fixed before execution.
shared_execution.official_evaluator_feedback: Exactly once after generation; never returned to the Agent.
shared_execution.budget_role: Request, Token, time, and resource settings are safety caps and outcome measurements, not success objectives.

outcomes.primary: End-to-end EnvBench Official success over all eight scheduled pairs; a scientifically eligible episode that forms no submission is a deployment failure.
outcomes.paired: Both pass, C-only pass, B-only pass, and both fail counts, with an exact two-sided McNemar test reported descriptively.
mechanism: clean replay attempts and fail-to-pass repairs
resources: input, output, cached, reasoning, and total Token

analysis_policy: Execute all eight pairs before changing either arm.
Report every scheduled episode, including non-submission and infrastructure censoring.
Do not add a package or repository-specific rule from any observed case.
Treat Official success, deployment completeness, path quality, and resources as separate axes.
Use this batch for development evidence only; final generalization claims require a later untouched test cohort and external baselines.

interpretation.positive_mechanism_evidence: C rescues a B non-submission or preserves a certified candidate after continued exploration without introducing a C-only failure mechanism.
interpretation.negative_mechanism_evidence: C and B form and submit the same candidates with no incumbent activation, or C loses a case because its intervention changes useful Agent behavior.
interpretation.no_hard_gate: The decision will use paired outcomes and trajectory explanation together; no post-hoc scalar threshold determines retention.
